# Simulation with Verilator

## Concepts

Simulation models, clocking, reset, test harnesses, and waveform-based observation.

## Implementation

Build a Verilator harness for SystemVerilog modules and a processor configuration.

## Hands-on Experiments

Run deterministic tests, capture waveforms, and reproduce a failing case.

For each experiment, record the tool versions, design configuration, commands, inputs, expected results, and observed results.
